long_biography.plain_text:
Bank Bira grew from a small regional lender into a significant Indonesian investment bank under Bambang Winarso Panutomo. He had joined its board after working in Chase Manhattan's Jakarta investment-banking team, then became chief executive and brought GE Capital in as a minority investor. The experience informed his creation of Malacca Trust, a Singapore-based holding structure for Indonesian financial businesses.

Beyond financial services, Panutomo established an Indonesian industrial-estate development and founded an indoor-farming venture. He also helped create a foundation that built a school for children from lower-income families. Indiana University, where he studied finance, recognised his entrepreneurship and invited him to advise its international business-school network.
